calls.head: Good looks against hopeful ones
calls.body: The Penguins are one of the league’s best for shot quality, at the dangerous end; the Jets are one of the league’s worst, at the hopeful end. Expect that gap to show.
calls.call: The Penguins’ shots are more dangerous on average than the Jets’.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 2 and 2 games this season
calls.happened: On how dangerous the average shot was, Pittsburgh had 7.0% a shot and Winnipeg 6.2% a shot. Coming in, Pittsburgh was at 6.6% a shot and Winnipeg at 5.9% a shot.
calls.usual: PIT 6.6% a shot · WPG 5.9% a shot
calls.tonight: PIT 7.0% a shot · WPG 6.2% a shot

calls.head: The Penguins get in close; the Jets shoot from distance
calls.body: On shots from in close, Pittsburgh is the league’s best and Winnipeg is around the middle of the league. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
calls.call: The Penguins take a bigger share of their shots from within 20 feet than the Jets.
calls.nums: Shots from in close: Pittsburgh 1st, Winnipeg 22nd
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 2 and 2 games this season
calls.happened: On share of 5-on-5 shots from within 20 feet, Pittsburgh had 38% and Winnipeg 23%. Coming in, Pittsburgh was at 34% and Winnipeg at 30%.

PIT.head: We gave Pittsburgh a 65% chance, but Winnipeg had other ideas.

WPG.head: We gave Winnipeg a 35% chance, and Winnipeg proved us wrong.

surprises.head: Winnipeg shut down Pittsburgh’s power play
surprises.body: Pittsburgh’s power play created 2.0 expected goals per 60, against their usual 7.7 and a league average of 7.6. A team strays this far about once every 35 games.

surprises.head: Winnipeg shortened their bench
surprises.body: Winnipeg’s bottom-six forwards played 39% of the forwards’ 5-on-5 time, against their usual 42% and a league average of 42%. A team strays this far about once every 7 games.

story.head: The Jets beat the Penguins
paras: Ben Kindel opened the scoring midway through the second. The game was tied twice. Cole Perfetti scored the winner midway through the third.
The chances were close to even, so this one could have gone either way. By our Swing measure, Alex Iafallo had the best night of anyone.

items.text: Both of the preview’s calls held.
